title: 第十五章  深藏不露
content_zh:
“依依姐，你说陈木他会不会有什么事啊？”孙依诗小声的说道，本来早上她想拿那颗蓝钻也是闹着玩的，准备玩一会就扔给王艺，不过没想到给陈木拦住了，明显王艺调查过了陈木，而王艺的手段，孙依诗自然也听说过。

    “应该不会有事吧，我总感觉陈木要比我们想象的要厉害。”苏林依虽然心里也有些担心，但心里总觉得陈木应该不会有事，这种奇怪的感觉，让她自己都觉得有点矛盾。

    “依依姐，要不我们将陈木给领回来吧，俗话说打狗还看主人呢，王艺看在你的面子上，应该会放过陈木。”孙依诗嘻嘻一笑，道。

    “小诗，我看你是想去看热闹吧。”苏林依白了孙依诗一眼，这小妮子想什么，她一清二楚，就算是陈木真被王艺给打的半死，孙依诗也不会有什么感觉，顶多是觉得失望。

    “依依姐，既然你都看出来了，要不就陪我一起去吧，万一去晚了，陈木被打伤了，我们都来不及救他了。”孙依诗见到自己的目的被苏林依戳穿，小脸上微红。

    “那你知道他们在哪里？”苏林依问道，孙依诗跟她两个人来到教室后，就没出去过，她还真不相信孙依诗能知道陈木他们在哪里。

    “当然知道啦，依依姐，跟我走吧！”苏林依一愣，随后就想起了，王艺好像每次打人都喜欢在学校的天台上，之所以在天台上，因为王艺觉得这样才能衬托出他的牛X，天台在整个学校的中央部位，人来人往不说，只要王艺教训人，都会有一群新生凑上去观望，这让王艺觉得自己就是整个学校的霸主一般。

    ……

    陈木没一会儿就跟余北来到了天台，王艺跟他的一众手下已经在这里等了一会，原本以为陈木不敢来，没想这小子真的不怕死，竟然还带了一个帮手来。

    余北自然而然已经被当成了陈木的帮手

    王艺挥了挥手，顿时周围的几人将陈木跟余北两人围了起来，众人中间留下了一个走道，王艺不紧不慢的从走道中穿了进来，道：“陈木，今天的事咱们暂且放开一旁不谈，昨天我摔了狗吃屎，是不是你做的！”

    王艺虽然已经确定了事情是陈木做的，就算不是陈木做的，只要他王艺认定是陈木做的，那就是陈木做的。
content_en:
"Sister Yiyi, do you think something will happen to Chen Mu?" Sun Yishi said in a low voice. Originally, she wanted to take the blue diamond as a joke in the morning. She was going to play with it for a while and then throw it to Wang Yi, but she didn't expect to be stopped by Chen Mu. It was obvious that Wang Yi had investigated Chen Mu, and Sun Yishi had naturally heard of Wang Yi's methods.

"It should be fine. I always feel that Chen Mu is more powerful than we thought." Although Su Linyi was a little worried, she always felt that Chen Mu would be fine. This strange feeling made her feel a little contradictory.

"Sister Yiyi, why don't we bring Chen Mu back? As the saying goes, it depends on the owner when beating a dog. For your sake, Wang Yi should let Chen Mu go." Sun Yishi said with a smile.

"Xiao Shi, I think you want to watch the fun." Su Linyi rolled her eyes at Sun Yi Shi. She knew exactly what this little girl was thinking. Even if Chen Mu Zhen was beaten half to death by Wang Yi, Sun Yi Shi would not feel anything at all. At most, she would feel disappointed.

"Sister Yiyi, since you have figured it out, why don't you go with me? If you go late and Chen Mu is injured, we won't have time to save him." Sun Yishi blushed slightly when she saw that her purpose was revealed by Su Linyi.

"Then do you know where they are?" Su Linyi asked. Sun Yishi and she had not left the classroom since they came to the classroom. She really didn't believe that Sun Yishi knew where Chen Mu and the others were.

"Of course I know, sister Yiyi, come with me!" Su Linyi was stunned, and then she remembered that Wang Yi seemed to like to hit people on the rooftop of the school. The reason why it was on the rooftop was because Wang Yi felt that this could bring out his awesomeness. The rooftop was in the center of the entire school, where people came and went without saying anything. Whenever Wang Yi taught someone, a group of freshmen would come to watch, which made Wang Yi feel like he was the overlord of the entire school.

…

Chen Mu followed Yu Bei to the rooftop soon after. Wang Yi and his men had been waiting here for a while. They originally thought that Chen Mu did not dare to come, but I didn't expect that this kid was really not afraid of death and even brought a helper.

Yu Bei has naturally been regarded as Chen Mu's helper

Wang Yi waved his hand, and several people around him immediately surrounded Chen Mu and Yu Bei. A walkway was left in the middle of the crowd. Wang Yi walked through the walkway unhurriedly and said: "Chen Mu, let's not talk about today's matter for now. Yesterday, I threw a dog and ate shit. Was it you who did it?"

Although Wang Yi has determined that Chen Mu did the thing, even if it was not done by Chen Mu, as long as Wang Yi confirms that it was Chen Mu who did it, then it was Chen Mu who did it.
